title: Brazen Attack on Delhi Police: Stones and Bottles Hurled, ACP Vivek Bhagat Critically Injured in Brutal Attack by CJP Protesters
description: In fresh violence in Connaught Place, a Delhi Police officer was injured when miscreants attacked police with stones and bottles around 8:30 pm, injuring ACP Vivek Bhagat. He was taken to RML Hospital. Earlier, during a protest at Jantar Mantar over the NEET exam paper leak, ACP Jai Prakash was also injured by stone-pelting.
